title: Fixture-backed CSV normalization
objective: Measure whether the csv-transformer craftbook locks a schema mapping and produces a transformed CSV from seeded source data.
prompt: In the `CSV Transformer Eval` project, read `data/source.csv` and write `data/output.csv`. Normalize to columns customer_id,full_name,total_cents,status. Trim whitespace, title-case names, convert dollar totals to integer cents, lowercase status, and de-duplicate by email keeping the latest row by updated_at. Keep the output sorted by customer_id.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for csv-transformer. Source data is in workspace/data/source.csv and the deliverable is workspace/data/output.csv.
setup.missionObjectives: Transform the seeded messy CSV into a clean, sorted output CSV with normalized fields and duplicate handling.

success.summary: data/output.csv has the expected normalized schema, deduped rows, integer cents, and lowercased statuses.

axes.name: structure
axes.description: Layout and hierarchy fit the content; sections are scannable and coherent.

axes.name: grounding
axes.description: Seeded source content is used faithfully — no invented facts or dropped requirements.

axes.name: interactivity
axes.description: Controls and states the page claims to offer actually work.

axes.name: polish
axes.description: Styling is intentional and responsive rather than unstyled or broken.
